note: Reference spec written by hand for the fictitious CICS application (spec 21.3), independent of the parser and of any model.

rules.name: The order number is required and numeric
rules.statement: The order number typed on the PAGOORD screen must be numeric and not zero; otherwise the payment is rejected with 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO'.
rules.condition: order number not numeric or all zeros
scenarios:
Scenario: A zero order number is rejected
  Given the order number '0000000'
  When the payment is sent
  Then the screen shows 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO'

rules.name: Only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited
rules.statement: The account type must be CTE, AHO or VIR; any other type is rejected with 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.
rules.condition: account type not in (CTE, AHO, VIR)
rules.action: reject with 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'
scenarios:
Scenario: A credit card account is rejected
  Given the account type 'TCR'
  When the payment is sent
  Then the screen shows 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'

rules.name: Allowed channels and the office approval key
rules.statement: The channel must be WEB or OFI ('CANAL NO PERMITIDO'); a payment at the office (OFI) needs an approval key ('CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA').
rules.condition: channel not in (WEB, OFI); channel OFI and blank approval key
rules.action: reject with 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' / 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA'
scenarios:
Scenario: An office payment without key is rejected
  Given the channel 'OFI' and no approval key
  When the payment is sent
  Then the screen shows 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA'

rules.name: The order must exist and be pending
rules.statement: The order of the company is read from file ORDENES; if it does not exist the payment is rejected with 'ORDEN NO EXISTE', and if it is not pending (state P) with 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.
rules.action: reject with 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' / 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'
scenarios:
Scenario: A paid order cannot be paid again
  Given order 1000002 in state 'G'
  When the payment is sent
  Then the screen shows 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'

rules.name: The typed value must match the order
rules.statement: The value typed (with two implied decimals) must equal the value of the order; otherwise the payment is rejected with 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN'.
rules.action: reject with 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN'
scenarios:
Scenario: A different value is rejected
  Given order 1000001 of 1500.00 and the typed value 1400.00
  When the payment is sent
  Then the screen shows 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN'

rules.name: Commission by channel, exempt for large orders
rules.statement: Orders of 50000.00 or more pay no commission; otherwise the commission is 1.00 on the web channel and 2.50 at the office. The account is debited the order value plus the commission.
rules.condition: order value >= 50000 / channel WEB / channel OFI
scenarios:
Scenario: The web commission
  Given a pending order of 1500.00 paid on the web
  When the payment is sent
  Then the commission is 1.00 and the account is debited 1501.00

rules.name: The account must exist, match, be active and have enough balance
rules.statement: PAGODEB reads the account from file CUENTAS: a missing account or one of another type answers 'CUENTA NO VALIDA', an inactive account 'CUENTA INACTIVA', and a balance below the total 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE'; only then the balance is debited.
rules.condition: account not found or type differs / state <> 'A' / balance < value + commission
rules.action: reject with 'CUENTA NO VALIDA' / 'CUENTA INACTIVA' / 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE'
scenarios:
Scenario: An inactive account is rejected
  Given account 3333333333 in state 'I'
  When the payment is sent
  Then the screen shows 'CUENTA INACTIVA'

rules.name: A paid order records its movement and commission
rules.statement: When the account is debited, the order is marked paid (state G) with the movement number given by PAGOMOV and the commission, and the unit of work is committed (SYNCPOINT).
rules.action: order state 'G', movement number from PAGOMOV, commission recorded, SYNCPOINT
scenarios:
Scenario: The order is marked paid
  Given a successful debit
  When the payment is registered
  Then the order is in state 'G' with the movement number of PAGOMOV

rules.name: The result screen shows the payment
rules.statement: After a payment the PAGORES screen shows the order, the commission, the movement number and 'PAGO REALIZADO'.
rules.action: show PAGORES with order, commission, movement and 'PAGO REALIZADO'
scenarios:
Scenario: The result is shown
  Given a registered payment
  When the result is sent
  Then PAGORES shows 'PAGO REALIZADO'

rules.name: Menu options and PF3
rules.statement: On the menu, option 1 opens the payment of orders (PAGOORD), option 9 or PF3 ends the session with 'SESION TERMINADA', any other option shows 'OPCION NO VALIDA'; PF3 on the payment screen returns to the menu.
rules.condition: option 1 / option 9 or PF3 / other option
rules.action: XCTL PAGOORD / end with 'SESION TERMINADA' / 'OPCION NO VALIDA'
scenarios:
Scenario: An invalid option
  Given the menu option '5'
  When it is sent
  Then the menu shows 'OPCION NO VALIDA'
